## Purpose
The ontology and catalog API. It serves the vocabulary (schemes and concepts, such as the industry → domain → subdomain tree), typed annotations that link resources (agents, tools, connectors, workflows, libraries) to concepts, the connected knowledge graph, goal scoping (how the planner narrows a goal), LLM classification, and the curated industry knowledge base.

## Responsibilities
- **Read:**
  - `GET /ontology` returns `{seeded, counts, schemes, predicates, subject_types, level_names}`.
  - `GET /ontology/tiers` returns `{tiers: tier_labels()}`, the single source for the UI's tier selects.
  - `GET /ontology/schemes`.
  - `GET /ontology/concepts?scheme=` returns a flat list with `level` and `level_name`; the UI nests it by `parent_id`.
  - `GET /ontology/concepts/{id}/descendants`.
  - `GET /ontology/concepts/{id}/usage` returns what deleting the concept would take with it; 404 if unknown.
- **Vocabulary create/update/delete:**
  - `POST /ontology/schemes` (201) with `{id, label, description}`; `PATCH` and `DELETE /ontology/schemes/{id}?cascade=`.
  - `POST /ontology/concepts` (201) with `{id, scheme_id, label, parent_id, definition, synonyms}`.
  - `PATCH /ontology/concepts/{id}` takes `clear_parent: true` to promote a concept to a root, which a nullable `parent_id` alone cannot express.
  - `DELETE /ontology/concepts/{id}?cascade=`.
  - Both deletes also run `delete_rules.forget_concepts_in_neo4j(concept_ids)`, returned under `neo4j`.
  - `VocabularyError` becomes 409.
- **Annotations:**
  - `GET /ontology/annotations?subject_type&predicate&concept_id&source&limit≤5000`.
  - `POST /ontology/annotations/bulk` with `{subject_type, subject_ids}`. Subjects with nothing recorded come back as empty maps rather than being left out.
  - `GET /ontology/annotations/{type}/{id}` returns `{annotations, sources: per predicate}`.
  - `PUT /ontology/annotations` with `{subject_type, subject_id, predicate, concept_ids, source="user"}` replaces the whole set for that subject and predicate.
  - `POST /ontology/annotations/one` (201) and `DELETE /ontology/annotations/one?…` add or remove one triple.
  - `DELETE /ontology/annotations/{type}/{id}` forgets everything about a subject.
- **Graph and scope:**
  - `GET /ontology/graph?kinds&scheme&root_concept&subject_type&search&include_orphans=true&hops(1–3)&include_processes` calls `ontology_graph.build_graph(client, ...)`. By default processes are drawn only when the graph is narrowed.
  - `GET /ontology/scope?goal=` is read-only and returns `{goal, scoped, domains, label, concepts, scores (top 8 domain scores), processes (process candidates), process_threshold}`.
  - `GET /ontology/scope/graph?goal=` returns the subgraph rooted at the matched domains, or an empty graph with `scoped: false`.
- **Classification.** `POST /ontology/classify` with `{name, description, instructions, subject_kind="agent", subject_type?, subject_id?}`:
  - runs `tagging.classify(...)`;
  - writes the result with `apply_classification` only when both subject fields are given (`include_tier` only for agents);
  - returns `{classified, result, written}`, or `{classified: false, detail: "The classifier returned nothing usable."}`.
- **Industry knowledge:**
  - `GET /ontology/knowledge?concept_id&kind&limit`.
  - `GET /ontology/knowledge/search?query&domains=a,b&kind&limit≤25` runs the same code path as the agent tool and returns `rendered: render_for_prompt(results)`.
  - `POST /ontology/knowledge` (201) with `{concept_id, title, body, kind="definition", tags}` and `source "user"`; a `ValueError` becomes 422.
  - `DELETE /ontology/knowledge/{id}`.
  - `GET /ontology/knowledge/agent/{agent_id}?query=` returns what that agent would retrieve: `{domains, scoped, results (≤8)}`.

## Key elements
`_vocab_guard(fn)` wraps store calls so that a `VocabularyError` becomes 409.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
- The catalog tables (`app/catalog/models.py`) and the knowledge reference table.
- Neo4j deletes.
- Mistral calls for classification and for the graph, which includes agents.

## Configuration
`PROCESS_MATCH_MIN_SCORE`.

## Interactions
- Route policy:
  - writes to annotations and classify accept agents, tools, workflows or catalog manage;
  - other GETs need catalog.view;
  - other writes need catalog.manage.
- Used by the frontend Catalog and Knowledge Graph pages and the create forms.

## Error handling and edge cases
- `/ontology/scope` swallows failures in the process-candidates lookup, logging them at debug level.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Writes from here carry `source="user"`.** That is what promotes a capability gap from advisory to publish-blocking.
- **Deletes report what they would break first.** Orphaning a concept id fails silently, because annotations point at concept ids.

## How to rebuild this file
The models and handlers above.
